name: SM64 Native Prototype
author: LilSmokeOS contributors
description: Native CPU-rendered Bob-omb Battlefield prototype with original Mario/Goomba meshes, coins, the eight-red-coin star goal, health, enemy damage/stomps, durable star progress and original-ROM sound effects. Not the complete game: other courses, music and the complete original behavior engine remain unfinished. Supply your US ROM inside original/.
